summary: Run 004 of the EFMP-302 Unit 3 G3 English review, against the frozen bundle at commit 70233c423b0747c99e1dca8b0928fc2d366126eb (git status --short clean before and after). The prepared manifest at specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-03/G3-run004/manifest.json was verified with the contract's own inputManifest(): 142 of 142 paths, zero missing, zero extra, zero digest mismatches, skill_digest equal. It was not refreshed. Two of the four run-003 blocking findings are genuinely repaired and were re-verified independently: MCQ item 10 now nests all four options in the built DOM at both viewports (40/40 options associated, the <ol>'s next sibling is the RRQ <h3>, not a stray <ul>), and every furlich2016 scope overstatement is gone, with the prose now disclosing that the abstract states no sample size and no country. All six deterministic gates exit 0 and every accessibility check passes. Disposition is escalate rather than revise: the residual defects are precise and mechanical, but this is the fourth review cycle on one submission against the skill's limit of two repair/review cycles per stage, so the remaining work is referred to the owner rather than sent to a fifth author round. This report is advisory. No qualification record, registry entry or trusted signature exists for this reviewer; nothing here constitutes acceptance, certification or sign-off.

[disposition rationale: repair-cycle limit exhausted] The review skill allows at most two repair/review cycles per stage per submission. This is the fourth review of EFMP-302 Unit 3 at G3 (runs 001, 002, 003, 004) and the third author repair round. Two of the four run-003 blocking findings are genuinely and verifiably repaired, so the cycle is not an unchanged-input retry; but the remaining defects are all in one file, specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-03.md, and one of them (the hurst2009/brookfield2017 ID lists leaving U3-11 undeclared) was present and undetected through three prior reviews. Continuing to return 'revise' would spend a fifth cycle against a stated limit of two. The disposition is therefore 'escalate': the residual work is precise, mechanical and listed above, but the decision to spend further cycles, and the question of why a mechanical cross-check between coverage/unit-03.md and sources/unit-03.md is not gated, belong to the owner.
